unit: Module 10 Are you going to Hong Kong? 旅行计划

unit_test.title: 第10单元「Module 10 Are you going to Hong Kong? 旅行计划」基础过关测验

questions.question: 「你要去香港吗？」的英文是（　）
options: Are you going to Hong Kong?
Do you going to Hong Kong?
You are going to Hong Kong?
Are you go to Hong Kong?
questions.answer: Are you going to Hong Kong?

questions.question: 肯定回答 Are you going to…?，应说（　）

questions.knowledge_point: 旅行词汇 travel / see / visit
questions.question: 「旅行」的英文是（　）
be going to 变疑问句时把 be 动词提到句首。

knowledge_summary.core_concept: 把 be 提到句首：Are you going to…? 答 Yes, I am. / No, I'm not.
knowledge_summary.key_formula: Are you going to Hong Kong? — Yes, I am.
knowledge_summary.tips: 有 be 就不再用 do。

knowledge_summary.point: 旅行词汇 travel / see / visit
knowledge_summary.core_concept: travel 旅行、see 看、visit 参观；What are you going to see? 你打算去看什么？
knowledge_summary.key_formula: What are you going to see?
common_mistakes: going to see 写成 going see。

questions.knowledge_point: 旅行词汇 travel / see / visit
questions.question: 「香港」的英文是（　）
「你打算去看什么？」的英文是（　）
options: What are you going to see?
What you are going to see?
What are you going to saw?
What do you going to see?
questions.answer: What are you going to see?
questions.explanation: 特殊疑问词 + be + 主语 + going to。

questions.knowledge_point: 旅行词汇 travel / see / visit
questions.question: visit 的意思是「参观、拜访」。
